answer: The nebula assignment is published and ivory records each panel. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the kernel graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 2842 identities would post 2173 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
